size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from the symptom, in the roles config that the auth middleware reads for several routes; the routes and controllers the prompt names are correct.
prompt: Admins get 403 Forbidden on GET /v1/users and when fetching another user with GET /v1/users/:userId. The same admin can still create, update and delete users.

root_cause.detail: The admin role's rights list has 'getUser' instead of 'getUsers', so routes guarded by auth('getUsers') reject admins unless they are reading their own id.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users > should return 200 and apply the default query options
tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users/:userId > should return 200 and the user object if admin is trying to get another user
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should return 200 and apply the default query options|should return 200 and the user object if admin is trying to get another user'
